publish.label: Tuesday, October 13, 2026
publish.why: Desk's call: Tuesday. Penny Young's Y14 event at the NAC is today and the Medeo results haven't been uploaded yet, so a Tuesday-morning check can add both. Monday evening works too; we'd mark those two as still to come.

desk_summary: Real issue this week. Lead: Maksim Milinkovic finished 12th of 121 in Cadet Elite at the October NAC, winning three straight elimination bouts from the 49th seed.

Most new pieces come from scraped or official websites, so they need your Vet before they can be included: the NAC results, the Elite/Challenger explainer, Veteran Worlds, NJ high-school dates, the TV box and a second signup board.
Still pending: Penny's Y14 result (being fenced today), the Medeo Youth Challenge results, and any NAC ratings, which aren't posted anywhere yet.
THE WEAPON fills the back page at two columns; Overheard on Reddit and Winter Camp are ready.

slots.title: Milinkovic Climbs to 12th at the First 'Elite' NAC
slots.summary: Maksim Milinkovic went from the 49th seed to 12th of 121 in Cadet Elite Men's Epee, winning DE bouts 15-14, 15-12 and 15-11 before a 10-15 loss in the round of 16. The day before, he went 6-0 in pools in a 233-fencer Div I Challenger field. Our three cadet women round out the story.
questions: OK to lead with Maksim? (Facts are from FencingTracker's results pages, so they need your Vet.)

flags.text: The Div I Elite winner's club is Elite Fencing Academy, not us. The copy will keep the two apart.

slots.summary: A short parent explainer on why NAC fields now say Elite or Challenger: big Cadet and Div I events split at 112 by national points. It explains why Maksim fenced Elite in Cadet and Challenger in Div I. From USA Fencing's Sept. 19 and 28 posts.
